<h2>Build an Empty sjSDM Tuning Result</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Constructs the typed empty tuning table and prediction cache used when no
candidate-fold work item is applicable.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>build_sjsdm_empty_tuning_result()
</code></pre>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Named list with 'data_tuning' and 'list_prediction_cache'.
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>build_sjsdm_empty_tuning_result()
</code></pre>
